technical.summary: Mixed signals with strong volume confirmation and short-term momentum, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: WY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (346+ days old) and neutral, with no recent insider conviction signals.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (344.6), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals, CPI event just passed, and earnings binary event in 14 days create compounded downside risk for WY.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), bullish OBV, stochastic cross, and extreme fear (34/100) create contrarian entry opportunity near support (29.81) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below EMA-50 and SMA-200, Ichimoku below cloud, earnings binary in 14 days, VIX crisis (344.6), macro headwinds (DXY, yield curve), and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unfavorable.

decision.entry_rationale: Volume spike and stochastic bullish cross offer short-term momentum, but price remains structurally below EMA-50 and SMA-200 with zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 14 days combined with VIX crisis (344.6) and macro headwinds (flat yield curve, rising DXY) create uncompensated downside risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding WY with 31 existing Real Estate positions (8.5% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk without fundamental justification.
